properties.name: 18-AP-0091
properties.notes: Demolition of the existing industrial units and redevelopment to provide a building ranging from one to nine storeys (32.55m AOD and 29.9m above ground) in height accommodating 1,093sqm of commercial floorspace at ground floor level incorporating industrial use (Use Class B8); retail uses (Use Class A1); and restaurants and cafe uses (Use Class A3) and 111 residential units (Class C3) at upper levels with associated works, including landscaping and 3 disabled car parking spaces.
